metadata.name: SearchApplication
metadata.description: This Api is Used for Searching and Fetching the Application Details.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: ID assigned to a Program a Specific Product ID is Inputted, then the Applications Created under that Product will be fetched Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:Fixed value provided by CoreCard.

request_fields.name: MerchantID
request_fields.description: A unique id generated by corecard sytem for a merchant. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXX Example: 205136549 Condition: MerchantNumber/MerchantAcctID is mandatory. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Merchant Number which is assgined to a Merchant. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXX Example: 205136549 Condition: MerchantNumber/MerchantAcctID is mandatory Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder/AccountHolder.*if a Specific Account Number is Inputted, then the Account Number specifc Application Details will be fetched Valid Values:0-9 Format :XXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404121234569. Note: This is a primary search parameter and can be used for direct search. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ApplicationNumber
request_fields.description: Unique Number generated for the Account creation Application .*if a Specific Application Number is Inputted, then the Application Number specific Application Details will be fetched Valid Values:0-9 Example:8002201421. Note: This is a primary search parameter and can be used for direct search.

request_fields.name: ApplicationStatus
request_fields.description: Status of the Application *if a Specific Application Status is Inputted, then the Status specific Applications Details will be fetched Valid Values: Value="1" Text="Approved" Value="2" Text="Declined" Value="6" Text="Review" Value="8" Text="Cancelled" Value="9" Text="Awaiting Decision" Value="10" Text="Internal Review" Value="16" Text="Pending" Value="18" Text="Auto-declined" Format:X Example:1 Note: This is a primary search parameter and can be used for direct search. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: First name of account holder*if a Specific Account/Application Holder First Name is Inputted, then the First Name specific Applications Details will be fetched Valid Values:A-Z Format :XXXXX Example:John. Condition: If primary parameters are not used for search, provide any two of the conditional parameters. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Last name of account holder *if a Specific Account/Application Holder Last Name is Inputted, then the Last Name specific Applications Details will be fetched Valid Values:A-Z Format :XXXXX Example:Smith. Condition: If primary parameters are not used for search, provide any two of the conditional parameters. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PreQualID
request_fields.description: This tag refer to Pre qualification ID.*if a Specific Prequal ID is Inputted, then the ID specific Applications Details will be fetched. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:10255556 Note: This is a primary search parameter and can be used for direct search. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: PreQualStatus
request_fields.description: This tag refer to Pre qualification Status.a Specific Prequal Status is Inputted, then the Status specific Applications Details will be fetched Valid Values:0-9Valid Values: 1-4 Value="1" Text="Incomplete PreQual" Value="2" Text="Declined" Value="3" Text="Expired" Value="4" Text="Utilized" Value="7" Text="Cancelled" Value="8" Text="KYC Verification Failed-Review" Format:X Example:2 Note: This is a primary search parameter and can be used for direct search. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: This Tag Defines how many number of Records will be Fetched in One Batch/Page ,If User didn’t Input any Value, then the Default Value as per System will be 50 Max Value Inputted can be 500. Valid Values:0-9 Format :XXX Example:50 Condition: Default Value will be 50 and Max Value Inputted must not exceed 500

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: This Tag Defines which Page Number of the Index of which the Records must be Fetched Valid Values:0-9 Format :XX Example:12 Condition: Default value would be 0

request_fields.name: MerchantNumberlist
request_fields.description: User can input one or multiple merchant numbers and get the results accordingly. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example:"1234,2345,3456" Condition: any one search criteria required

request_fields.name: EmailID
request_fields.description: Card holder's Email ID. Valid Values:0-9,A-Z Format : [email protected] Example: [email protected] . Note: This is a primary search parameter and can be used for direct search. Allowable Values: 300

request_fields.name: SSNLast4Digits
request_fields.description: Card holder's last four digit of SSN. Valid Values:1120 Format :XXXX Example:1120 Condition: If primary parameters are not used for search, provide any two of the conditional parameters. Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: MobilePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Mobile Phone Number. Valid Values:0-9 Format :XXXXXXXXXX Example:987567757 Note: This is a primary search parameter and can be used for direct search. Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateOfBirth
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Date of Birth. Valid Values:0-9 Format :MM/dd/yyyy Example: 02/01/2020 Condition: If primary parameters are not used for search, provide any two of the conditional parameters.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
